name: Escape the Corset movement

lead: Escape the Corset is a South Korean movement of women who reject the country's demanding beauty standards, including heavy makeup, long multi-step skincare and cosmetic procedures. Participants frame bare faces and short hair as a way to look the way they choose.
It appeared around 2018 alongside the Me Too movement and the wider debate on women's rights in Korea.

paras: Participants post pictures of destroyed makeup, cut their hair short and go without cosmetics in public. It is a social stance rather than a product or routine.
Participants have described social pressure and backlash. The movement has also been debated, for example whether beauty pressure reflects male dominance or social status competition among women.

South Korean Women 'Escape the Corset' and Reject Their Country's Beauty Ideals

angle.text: Participants present a natural, low-maintenance appearance as the goal itself, saving time and effort and rejecting expectations.

lead: Escape the Corset, or the post-corset movement, is a movement in South Korea where women reject strict beauty standards and the makeup and grooming expected of them. Wikipedia places it in 2018, unfolding along with the Me Too movement and rising interest in women's rights [1].

Coverage by CNN in January 2019 framed it as a challenge to a male-dominated society; the article was discussed on Hacker News, where commenters debated that framing [2]. For readers interested in appearance, it documents a counter-position to maximal grooming: looking natural as a deliberate choice.

paras: The movement unfolded in 2018 alongside the Me Too movement in South Korea and interest in women's rights, as abortion law was also being debated [1].

CNN covered the movement in an article titled 'Escape the corset: South Koreans pushing back against beauty standards,' which was shared on Hacker News in 2019 [2]. Commenters debated whether beauty standards serve the male gaze, are driven by acceptance seeking, or are status competition among women [2].
